definitions.explanation: The practice of reducing electricity consumption, both as an individual habit and as a social movement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{節電|せつでん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{心|こころ}がけている→心がける：10015_kokorogakeru⟧。
examples.english: In summer, I try to conserve electricity.

examples.japanese: {節電|せつでん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{設定温度|せっていおんど}→設定温度：23470_setteiondo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|あ}げた→上げる：02443_ageru⟧。
examples.english: I raised the air conditioner's temperature setting to save electricity.

examples.japanese: ⟦{政府|せいふ}→政府：03294_seifu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{節電|せつでん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}びかけている→呼びかける：06480_yobikakeru⟧。

notes:
COMPOSITION: ⟦{節|せつ}→節：19359_setsu⟧ (economize, moderate) + {電|でん} (electricity).

CONTEXT: {節電|せつでん} became especially prominent after the 2011 Tōhoku earthquake and Fukushima nuclear disaster, when Japan faced power shortages.

COMMON MEASURES:
- Raising AC temperature in summer (⟦{冷房|れいぼう}→冷房：01755_reibou⟧ to 28°C)
- Lowering heater temperature in winter (⟦{暖房|だんぼう}→暖房：01657_danbou⟧ to 20°C)
- Turning off lights when not needed
- Using LED lighting
- Reducing standby power

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{省|しょう}エネ→省エネ：06308_shouene⟧: energy saving (broader term)
- ⟦{節水|せっすい}→節水：07964_sessui⟧: water conservation
- ⟦{節約|せつやく}→節約：03302_setsuyaku⟧: saving (general), economizing
- ⟦{電力|でんりょく}→電力：14609_denryoku⟧{不足|ぶそく}: power shortage

- {節電|せつでん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to save electricity
- {節電|せつでん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{呼|よ}びかける→呼びかける：06480_yobikakeru⟧: to call for power saving
